Community Animal Rescue and Care Proposal
Fictional test document — for software testing only
Applicant: Happy Tails Animal Rescue
Project duration: 1 April 2027 – 31 March 2028
Funding requested: ■8,50,000
Project objective
Provide coordinated food, basic veterinary care and vaccination support for rescued and community
animals in the fictional service area of Greenfield District.
Planned activities
1. Purchase and distribute animal food based on documented need.
2. Arrange veterinary consultations and emergency referrals.
3. Conduct vaccination and sterilization drives with qualified veterinary partners.
4. Maintain animal intake, treatment and adoption records.
5. Publish periodic donation and expenditure summaries.
Illustrative targets
Support 200 animals with food; provide 120 veterinary consultations; administer 180 vaccinations;
support 50 sterilization procedures; and maintain complete records for all project-funded activities.
Monitoring
Progress will be tracked using dated service records, veterinary invoices, donation ledgers and quarterly
expenditure summaries. Targets are planned outputs and should not be represented as achieved
results.
